title: Add chat command rate limiting and cmdQueue size cap
description: P1 council-identified finding. The cmdQueue array in MineflayerAdapter/index.js has no max length — unbounded memory growth under command flood. No rate limiting on chat/command pipeline. Add cmdQueue size cap (e.g., 100) and rate limiting to the chat pipeline. Source: codebase-audit-20260711-10agent-swarm-5chair-council-post-wave-c.md (P1-010).
